entry.title: Enter Gandalf the White
entry.cost: One Will of the West result.
entry.timing: During your normal action. Additional dice enter at the next Recover, never immediately.

conditions.description: An eligible entry die is available.
A qualifying Minion has entered at least once. Gandalf the Grey is outside the Fellowship: replace him in his region, or return after his elimination in Fangorn or an unconquered Elven stronghold.

entry.title: Enter Aragorn
entry.cost: One Will of the West result.
entry.timing: During your normal action. Additional dice enter at the next Recover, never immediately.

conditions.description: An eligible entry die is available.
Strider is outside the Fellowship, in unconquered Minas Tirith, Dol Amroth or Pelargir. Replace the same figure.

entry.title: Enter Lord Elrond
entry.timing: During your normal action. Additional dice enter at the next Recover, never immediately.

conditions.description: An eligible entry die is available.
Elrond has never entered. Sauron or the Elves are at war and Rivendell is unconquered.

entry.title: Enter Lady Galadriel
entry.timing: During your normal action. Additional dice enter at the next Recover, never immediately.

conditions.description: An eligible entry die is available.
Galadriel has never entered. Sauron or the Elves are at war and Lórien is unconquered.

availability.title: Change die result
availability.cost: Transfer this Ring to Shadow.
availability.timing: During your normal action, before using the changed die.

conditions.description: At most one ordinary Ring change per player each turn.
A Ruler token has not been used this turn.
An unused non-Eye standard or Ruler die is available; Keeper and Lesser Minion dice cannot be changed.

availability.title: Use Vilya
availability.cost: Transfer this Ring to Shadow.
availability.timing: After the entire paid action resolves, before completing its cost.

conditions.description: A Ruler token has not been used this turn; ordinary Ring use does not consume this ability.
Elrond is in play and a paid die other than a Will of the West can be retained.

availability.title: Awaken
availability.cost: One Muster result (including Army/Muster or Will of the West), or any available Ruler result.
availability.timing: During your normal action.

Denethor requires an active nation.
A permitted destination is reachable within the sovereign's movement, respecting sieges and card restrictions.
An eligible awakening die is available; current table-card restrictions apply.
